## bbaef38af096

**Reproduced curriculum defect.** Generator SHA-256 `b5358677d7baf563f96e02b6de182c993581faa7b36c05d6001b963676f74d1d`; rule hash `45b046104405`.

The target validator rejects all three canonical inputs even though the selected Racket rule reproduces their expected outputs. On canonical `train[0]`, it reports “expected 2-5 distinct motif colors, got 1” and “color 1 should form one connected motif, found 4.” The generator therefore imposes a multi-color connected-motif template that excludes the actual canonical four-singleton case. A 60-draw profile-floor check found 0 exact canonical-profile hits and 0 envelope hits.

The concrete input, expected output, supported Racket application, hashes, command, and findings are retained in `checks/audit/bbaef38af096/input.json`, `expected.json`, `racket.json`, and `finding.json`. The input is canonical and rule-lawful but fails the target validator. `selfcheck`, `profile_floor`, and `defect_lint` all failed in their retained audit directories. This target was not modified.
